header: Public reference exchange rates for the currency converter of the search bar. The browser does the sum; this route only fetches and caches the rates, and it reads nothing from the user: no body, no query, no cookie, no log of what anyone converted. Sources (free, no key): Frankfurter (European Central Bank reference rates; many currencies including INR), and open.er-api.com for the Gulf currencies the ECB does not publish. If either fails I use the other; both failing gives a plain 503 and the card says "rates unavailable right now".
